text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
? Is that the Funabashi Maru over there?
Why is it in the city...?

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I'm in the middle of work.
Transporting cargo between Funabashi and Tokyo, you see.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
! Mister, it's been a long time!
Fufu, I recognized your familiar boat right away.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
"Meeting here must be fate.
Care to take a cruise with me all the way to Funabashi?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Incredible propulsion...! Even after taking all those detours,
we've already reached Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
There's also something I want to show you.
Hey, remember that park over there?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
! That's where I got lost...!
I was chasing a big butterfly, and then...

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Your father and I searched together.
To think it'd grow this big...

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Thanks. ...Seeing you tear it up at the JRA always gives me courage.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you want to get off here?
I could give you a ride all the way to Tokyo...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No. I want to run home.
In order to really "lay it down."

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
! Hahaha!
Is that so? I'll be cheering for you from right here!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Phew— Though, will I make curfew?
What time is it now...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh? It hasn't been that long...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To think I could soak in so many memories in such a short time.
As expected, the propulsion of a ship is truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Catch the wave firmly... no, is it engine RPM?
Increase the pace of the high knees...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Running all the way back to the academy, she immediately put what she learned from the ship's propulsion into practice!
